newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank cuts repo, bill rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank cuts repo, bill rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it had cut interest rates on its termed reverse repos and its 90-day special series treasury bills.

Coupon rates on five-day and one-month reverse repos were cut to 10.5625 percent. The five-day reverse repos were at 10.625 percent on Wednesday, while the one-month reverse repos were at 10.75 percent.
The Central Bank reduced the rate for the two-month reverse repos to 10.625 percent from 10.875 percent.
The bank withdrew the 11.0 percent coupon three-month reverse repos from its lending window.
The special series Treasury bill rates were also cut to 10.6 percent for the 90-day bills from the previous 10.62 percent.
The 132-day bill rate was unchanged at 10.90 percent.
